scope.purpose: bounded directional capability pilot after the clean 10M architecture proxy
scope.claim_limit: single-seed pilot; not final 35M or at-least-5-TPP architecture evidence

mechanical_validity: all recorded values must be finite
checkpoint SHA-256 and parent lineage must form the declared chain
midtrain and SFT must realize nonzero supervised token accounting
train/evaluation overlap audits must remain zero
actual execution device and dtype must be recorded
interpretation.midtrain_and_sft: Report held-out pre, post, and delta values without a significance claim. Lower held-out loss and higher token or exact-sequence accuracy are directional evidence only.
interpretation.rl: realized_optimizer_updates greater than zero is required to call the RL stage informative. Zero updates is classified as zero_signal. Report held-out exact-match, format-validity, and reward deltas even when they are zero or negative.
interpretation.deployment_checkpoint: Use the SFT checkpoint for structured-action export because autoregressive RL invalidates the structured heads unless they are retrained afterward.

report: all parse, validation, provider, and byte-verification failures

limitations: 10M model trained at approximately one loss token per parameter before the pilot
offline canonical exact-reward RL rather than BrowserGym or live-web RL
exact-prompt holdout does not claim template-family or primitive-value disjointness
single Apple M5 browser/runtime deployment condition
